title: yadakchi.offers.enriched.v1
description:
A structured Offer: one seller's listing after Persian normalization and field extraction.

Producers: enricher. Consumers: fitment, matcher.
Kafka message key: offer_uid — it must be set; compaction and partition ordering depend on it.
Cleanup: delete, retention 90 days.

This file validates a whole Kafka message body: the shared envelope from docs/specs/02-EVENT-CONTRACTS.md plus this topic's payload. Unknown fields are ignored, never rejected, at both levels — that is what lets a producer add an optional field without breaking a consumer.

event_id.description: UUIDv4, unique per emission. Two emissions of the same fact carry different event_ids; consumers deduplicate on the payload's natural identity, not on this.

event_type.description: The topic name without the 'yadakchi.' prefix and without the version suffix.

version.description: Envelope and payload version. A removed field, a renamed field or a changed type is a breaking change: publish to .v2 and run both until consumers migrate.

occurred_at.description: When the fact happened, ISO-8601 UTC with Z. Consumers tolerate out-of-order delivery across partitions by comparing this, never by assuming global ordering.

producer.description: The service that emitted this message. Constrained to the producers declared for this topic in platform/kafka/topics.yml.

trace_id.description: Propagated across the whole chain for debugging. Minted by crawler on the listings.observed topic and carried through every derived event; a service starting a chain of its own (a human admin edit, a scheduled recomputation) mints a fresh one. Every service logs it.

payload.description: Emitted only when something material changed for this offer_uid, or when normalizer_version changed. A pure re-observation with identical values emits nothing. This topic is not compacted, so payload is never null; there is no tombstone on a delete-retention topic.

source_key.description: Stable slug of the source, carried through from listings.observed.

external_key.description: The seller's own id or url path, carried through from listings.observed.

seller_key.description: Stable slug of the seller behind this listing, minted by crawler.

raw_title.description: The seller's title, untouched. Kept alongside the normalized form.

title_normalized.description: The cleaned title: character-unified, ZWNJ-normalized, promotional tokens stripped. This is what reaches page titles and search text.

brand.description: Canonical brand key, not the surface form. null when no brand was extracted.

part_number.description: Normalized part number: uppercase, no separators. null when none was extracted — absence is normal and is never forced.

part_type.description: Controlled vocabulary key, e.g. brake_pad_front. null when the title resolved to no known type.

authenticity_claim.description: The seller's stated grade. This is a claim and is never verified.

pack_quantity.description: How many units one listing sells. Defaults to 1.

price_toman.description: Integer tomans, never rials and never a float. null when the price was ambiguous under every interpretation — enricher never guesses.

stock_status.description: Mapped stock state. Absence maps to unknown, never in_stock.

vehicle_hints.description: Raw vehicle-looking strings the listing claims the part DOES fit, unresolved. Resolving them is fitment's job. Positive claims only — a string here is never evidence against any other vehicle.

vehicle_hints_excluded.description:
Raw vehicle-looking strings the listing explicitly claims the part does NOT fit — "مناسب صندوق‌دار نیست", "برای تیپ ۲ نیست". Unresolved, like vehicle_hints, and carrying the seller's own words.

OPTIONAL and additive: a producer that extracts no negative claims may omit it entirely, which is why it is not in required. An ABSENT or EMPTY array means 'no negative claim was extracted' — it never means 'fits everything'. Absence of a vehicle from vehicle_hints likewise means nothing: only an entry here is evidence of incompatibility. fitment's Rule 5 needs claim polarity to tell a genuine seller disagreement from a vehicle nobody mentioned, and inferring a negative from silence would be guessing.

overbroad_claim.description: true when the listing claimed something like "مناسب تمام پژوها". fitment rejects such claims as sole evidence and needs to know they were present.

confidences.description: Field name → confidence in [0,1]. Derived from match specificity, competing matches or model certainty — never fabricated.

extraction_provenance.description: Field name → how that field was obtained.

normalizer_version.description: Version of the normalizer and extractors that produced this record.

first_seen_at.description: First observation of this offer_uid. A reprocess must never reset it.

last_seen_at.description: Most recent observation of this offer_uid.

is_active.description: false once the listing has disappeared from the source.
